primitiveBudget: one generated contiguous pressure slab, nine overlapping channels, grain filaments, remote contour recasts, and four liftable pressure events
commitThreshold: a directional crossing must travel, align with the slab grain, and meet resistance
memoryRule: a pressure trace remains geometry-neutral until all three thresholds pass; the contacted channel stays exact while an untouched channel gains contours, density, angle, phase, and mass; four recasts persist
interactionRule: pointer or touch drags along the slab grain; Enter or Space and the press control make an equivalent deterministic crossing; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: Canvas absence kernels, DOM shutters, and planar return mask -> one contiguous Canvas 2D material slab of overlapping pressure channels
compositionRupture: sparse vertical ledger, oblique stack, and centered mask -> a single off-axis pressure body with internal grain and load-bearing channels
encounterRupture: enter-and-leave, sustained local gaze, and return cadence -> directional pressure stroke that must cross a material threshold
temporalRupture: remote absence, local fold, and sealed return -> continuous latent load that crystallizes as a remote material re-production on release
mediumRupture: open Canvas kernels, semantic DOM geometry, and planar Canvas mask -> generated Canvas 2D slab geometry with actual contour and density production
changedRule: Material is not a skin over geometry: only a grain-aligned pressure crossing that travels far enough and meets resistance re-produces an untouched channel; the contacted channel remains exact.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is one dark contiguous slab of nine overlapping channels. A valid crossing leaves no local scar and changes an untouched remote channel's contour count, density, angle, phase, and mass; four recasts remain visible.
falsifier: Delete if the trace paints itself, if a short or misaligned crossing commits, if the source changes, if remote material is only colour or readout, if later recasts reset, or if the blind slab reads as a generic ribbon field.
deletionCondition: Delete v043 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the resistance portrait from v040-v042 or if resistance is merely explanatory prose attached to a drag.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
